desc:
Welcome to Escape Plan! (The best prison RP!)

👮‍♀️ Choose the life of a guard, serving to maintain the peace and uphold order within the prison by subduing hostile inmates, confiscating contraband, and assisting the police in their efforts of catching criminals, climbing your way to the top of the ranks!

⛓️ Or perhaps you're more suited to the life of an inmate? Sentenced to life behind bars, your job is to form an escape plan and free yourself from the jail, crushing any opposition in your way!

❤️ Make sure to leave a like for more updates!

Inspired by Redwood Prison and Prison Life
